items.title: 68145_Jimmie Rowles oral history interview
items.q: I met Placido Domingo at Bradley's... I said, 'This is Placido Domingo... And he and I are gonna do an opera together.'

ctx.x: Chicks, chicks, it's gotta be chicks. I'll bet you that Nastase is a piece of work. I'd like to know him. You know, I met Placido Domingo at Bradley's, of all
